title: What a Bountiful Harvest, Demon Lord!
altTitles: It's a Bountiful Harvest, Demon Lord!
Bội Thu Rồi, Ma Vương Đại Nhân!
description: Jangcheol Kim, an agricultural science student, is transported into the fantasy MMORPG Paladins of Blood and awakens as Credos, the game's final boss and Demon Lord. He knows that invading the human world will get him killed by the max-level hero he raised, while stopping the invasion will leave him at the mercy of his starving demon generals. With no good options, he turns to the one thing he knows best: farming. By growing food and solving his demons' hunger crisis, the Demon Lord begins building an unexpectedly prosperous kingdom.
author: BK_Moon
